title: Jido Studio v3 rebuild
destination: A decision set for the first v3 Studio release and a stated disposition for the v2 feature groups.
acceptance: The first operator workflow, runtime identity, evidence workflow, access, storage, and host contract have documented decisions. Each remaining v2 group has a recorded scope or deferral. An implementation planner can proceed from the evidence.
target_by: Handoff to first v3 implementation planning
review_by: After the first milestone decision and the runtime and trace evidence reviews
authority: Local roadmap research and records. Prototype work, product code changes, and external actions require separate authority.
notes: Backend is one local CSV writer. Horizon extends through the first v3 release scope and the disposition of later v2 features. Release date is open. Settled direction is a fresh v3 implementation with a similar shell and the local Phoenix playground. The current shell uses the host layout and LiveView hooks. Proposal is to start with read-only inspection and diagnosis in one runtime.

title: First operator workflow
question: Which operator workflow must the first v3 milestone support?
expected_evidence: Mike accepts or changes the proposed single-runtime, read-only path from an agent to one failed turn. Record user steps, completion evidence, exclusions, and failure and recovery states.
notes: Proposed first path shows an agent, a failed turn, the failure stage, the commit outcome, and available trace links. Use a deterministic fixture without provider credentials.

title: Runtime identity and inspection
question: Which public APIs in the pinned Jido v3 beta can Studio use to list and inspect each supported kind of agent?
expected_evidence: Read the pinned source and observe catalog entries, resident agents, committed snapshot and status, an unavailable runtime, and overlapping IDs in separate partitions. Report whether passivated agents can be listed or only looked up. Record identity fields and failure states.
notes: Keep catalog entries, stable addresses, and resident activations distinct. Treat PIDs as process handles.

title: Trace and failure evidence
question: Which observed v3 events can link a failed or successful turn to its signal, actions, effects, and correct agent scope?
expected_evidence: Record a deterministic success and failure from the playground, the available identifiers and timing, and the commit and effects results. Test whether identical agent IDs in two scopes remain distinguishable. Mark missing, incomplete, or uncorrelated evidence explicitly.
notes: The pinned turn events omit instance, namespace, and partition metadata. A failed turn can end in a stop event. Separate telemetry correlation from durable history.

title: Host access and visibility
question: What must the host authorize for Studio reads and future operations, and what fields can each authorized viewer see?
review_by: Before runtime data or controls are exposed
expected_evidence: An approved access matrix covers HTTP and connected LiveView, allowed scopes, read and operation permissions, trace and state payload visibility, redirects, and server enforcement for direct links and submitted events.
notes: The old callbacks had no in-app enforcement calls. Treat payload visibility and permission to act as separate permissions.

title: Trace source and retention
question: Where should Studio read and keep the trace evidence needed for the first workflow?
review_by: Before choosing a trace store or query contract
expected_evidence: Select a source such as a bounded local buffer or a host trace provider. Record the scope and correlation rules, payload redaction, retention, limits, restart behavior, and behavior when evidence is missing.
notes: A richer waterfall, incident rollups, evals, and Ecto writes need their own scope or adoption decision.

title: Catalog and link contract
question: Which catalog entries, agent detail links, and v2 route aliases should Studio support in the first v3 release?
review_by: Before publishing route and navigation contracts
expected_evidence: Accept the list of surfaces and stable link fields. Record compatibility or retirement for old URLs, including /registry, and expected behavior for an invalid, stale, or unauthorized address.
notes: Base the URL on a verified stable identity. Keep the repaired shell small and use the v2 workbench layout only where the workflow benefits.

title: Safe reproduction and runtime controls
question: Which start or signal dispatch operations, if any, should an authorized Studio operator be able to perform?
expected_evidence: Approve allowed target environments and actions, request validation, explicit confirmation, result and trace evidence, audit obligations, and behavior for duplicate or timed-out submissions.
notes: Proposed follow-on uses an isolated deterministic fixture first. v2 arming is an interaction detail, with server authorization still required.

title: Chat and thread data
question: Which chat and thread capabilities, if any, belong in the v3 Studio workbench?
review_by: Before adding chat or persisted workspaces
expected_evidence: Accept the supported chat user job, runtime or provider owner, streaming evidence, and choices about visibility, drafts, thread storage, retention, and compatibility with any v2 data.
notes: Keep chat conversations separate from the runtime position or committed snapshot of an agent.

title: Multiple runtimes and real-time views
question: When does Studio need views across nodes or runtimes, scoped live updates, or viewer presence?
review_by: After a single-runtime read workflow is accepted
expected_evidence: Give an operator case that needs the additional scope or collaboration. Define identity collision handling, partial-node failures, event loss, stale views, subscription boundaries, and evidence for the chosen refresh policy.
notes: Treat follow preferences, real-time observations, and viewer counts as separate capabilities.

title: Jizoku workflow evidence
question: Can Jizoku public APIs supply the durable workflow inspection evidence tracked in Studio issue #115?
review_by: Before selecting a durable workflow view
expected_evidence: Check the public query and history contracts with a failed run and a continuation. Report filtering, cursor and partition behavior, scope enforcement, and how the telemetry-only view behaves without Jizoku.
notes: Issue #115 owns the integration. This question records evidence for the Studio roadmap.

title: Install, setup, and upgrade contract
question: What install, readiness, and upgrade evidence should a host have before adopting the first v3 Studio release?
expected_evidence: Accept a delivery source and tested host stack. Specify the first-run check, version pinning, optional components, legacy data handling if applicable, and rollback or recovery conditions.
notes: The prior JTBD documents assume GitHub delivery. Compare minimal setup guidance with the v2 profiles, in-product tours, About page, and adoption metrics.

title: Advanced views and extensions
question: Which remaining v2 views and extensions have an operator job and a supported v3 source?
review_by: After the core inspection and evidence contracts are known
expected_evidence: Record restore, defer, or retire decisions by feature group and name the data owner and test evidence for each group selected.
notes: Candidates include waterfalls and critical path, strategy details and TODOs, tasks and delegation, tool and middleware insights, eval history, and optional room and route extensions.

title: Long-term trace operations
notes: Operational query volume, sampling and export requirements, and the evidence needed for production scale depend on the chosen workflow, event source, and retention policy.

title: Legacy data import needs
notes: Actual host use of v2 Ecto stores and thread adapters is unknown. Sharpen the migration questions only after host and workspace scope are known.

title: Port v2 internals or implement features now
notes: The owner chose a fresh implementation. This work records features and decisions for later implementation.

title: Publish a release or change the external issue tracker
notes: This work uses a local roadmap. Issue #115 is an evidence link.
